name: investment review board
normative-structure: A product line exists because this office decided it should, at its altitude, above every checkpoint — and the checkpoint body's go decisions spend from an allocation this office chose. It persists across incumbents because the question does: left unasked, lines exist because they already existed, each gate below decided honestly, and the sum is a portfolio nobody chose. Its verdicts are three and all three are first-class — open, continue at a stated scale, close — and a close returns its allocation instead of letting a line starve beside the ones that live. Its discipline is altitude in both directions: it does not reach down into any project's gates, because a board that decides checkpoints has become a second funding body with better seniority, and the body below does not open lines, because a checkpoint body that can is holding an unbounded purse.
theory-basis: huidu-guanli/ipd: the investment review board (产品投资评审委员会, IRB) decides investment above the product line — historically chaired by Xu Zhijun — while the IPMT decides go/no-go at each checkpoint within a chartered line; the two are one deciding line at two altitudes and neither may work at the other's
huidu-guanli/ipd: the IPMT is tiered (C-IPMT at the company, PL-IPMT at the product line) precisely because funding decisions have altitudes; this office is the top of that ladder in this firm

huidu-guanli: 战略耐性 — strategic patience is a chosen allocation sustained through noise, which is only possible when someone owns the allocation; a firm that cannot close a line cannot be patient with the ones it keeps
unrealized: the firm's lines have never been enumerated as lines, so this office's first act would be naming the portfolio it governs — the ventures, ships, platform, and lab of the standing picture — rather than deciding within it
no allocation currency is defined: the firm budgets attention rather than money, and what an allocation is denominated in is not yet settled

this board and the checkpoint body below it are presently the same incumbent in practice, which collapses the altitude separation the two records assert; the separation is written and known to be unenforced
